title: premium_flooded is a sticky bool beside CardState and is never cleared
trigger: A free user opens the AI compose box and a request fails with AICOMPOSE_FLOOD_PREMIUM; they then buy Premium from the Increase Limit button (or switch to Fix/another tab and get a good result) without closing the box.
effect: footer() keeps returning IncreaseLimit for the life of the box, so a Ready result cannot be applied, and dialog.rs hides the loading spinner for later requests (loading && !premium_flooded).
fix: Make the flood a CardState::Failed(AiBoxError) variant (or derive it from the last card) so the next request or accepted result leaves it.

title: A failed Fix request has no retry: set_mode(same mode) returns None and the card stays Failed
trigger: Open the box, switch to the Fix tab, the request fails (network error, TooLong or an empty answer); click the Fix tab again.
effect: Card shows the original text with a disabled Apply and no spinner; the only way to ask again is to switch to another tab and back (or close and reopen).
fix: Give CardState::Failed a retry transition (re-clicking the active tab or a Retry action calls request() when the card is Failed).

title: bound_style_name is app-wide but custom styles are per account
trigger: Account A binds its custom style 'pirate' to the apply-in-place shortcut; switch to account B (no such style) and press the shortcut in a chat.
effect: The request fails with a style-invalid error, apply_in_place.rs clears the binding for the whole app, so account A's binding is lost; with a same-named different style in B the wrong style rewrites the text.
fix: Key the binding by AccountKey (map AccountKey -> style name) or store it in the account's settings.

title: A finished deep-link flow (ShowText / ChatReady) blocks every later link until the UI consumes it
trigger: A launch link ends in ShowText or ChatReady while the surface that consumes it is not drawn (locked, window closed), then another tg:// link is opened.
effect: request_deep_link_info returns Ok(None) for each new link; links silently do nothing until the stale state is consumed.
fix: Let a new launch link replace any non-ResolvingInfo stage, or give every stage an owner window and a Farewell closer.

title: gift_text_length_max fetch error is ignored and a comment then silently blocks the purchase
trigger: getOption send fails once (or answers an error), then buy with a comment
effect: buy_marketplace_gift returns InvalidRequest (max.is_none_or) without setting a note; the Buy button does nothing
fix: Set gift.note on the Err return, and refetch the limit when None

title: A new launch clears the unconsumed open result without closing the app TDLib already started
trigger: Open mini app A; its answer lands in open_result as Opened{launch_id}; before the UI poll takes it (or while its window is locked/refused) open mini app B.
effect: mark_web_app_pending sets open_result=None (and finish_web_app_open overwrites it) without pushing A's launch_id to dropped_launches, so closeWebApp is never sent for A and the bot keeps a live session.
fix: Make open results a per-request map or queue keyed by RequestId, and route every discarded Opened through dropped_launches.

title: Emoji-status switch moves before the send and is not put back when the send fails
trigger: Open a mini app's permission box, flip 'allow emoji status' while the client cannot send (closing, native send error).
effect: The bot's can_manage_emoji_status stays flipped though no request went out and no error answer will ever restore it (apply_web_app_error is the only rollback).
fix: Stage the change as a pending request with a RequestRollback (as set_forum_topic_muted does), or flip only after a successful send.

title: VenueBot::Resolving has no exit except an answer; open() resets only Failed
trigger: Open Send Location with the venue bot not yet resolved, drop the searchPublicChat request (connection restart / request purge) or have it answered before the bot user is cached (then Missing is final).
effect: Venue list stays on Loading (Resolving arm sends nothing) for every later picker of the session, or shows no venues for the whole session after Missing.
fix: Reset Resolving and Missing to Unknown in open() (as Failed is), and when the session's requests are dropped.

title: Venue search generation restarts at 0 for every opened picker, so a late answer of a closed picker is accepted by the next one
trigger: Open Send Location, pan/search so a getInlineQueryResults is in flight (generation N), close the box, reopen Send Location in the same or another chat and make the same number of venue queries (generation N again) before the old answer lands.
effect: venues_answered matches only on generation, so the old picker's venues (another place or chat) appear and are cached under the new picker's request point.
fix: Make the generation a LocationSharing-wide counter that is never reset (or carry a picker id in the purpose and compare chat_id and point).

title: Closing the venue search after a failed list lookup leaves the venue list on Loading
trigger: Open Send Location while the venue bot lookup fails (offline or bot error, list shows nothing found), type one letter in the search field, close the search within 900 ms
effect: The venue list shows the loading spinner and nothing is pending; it stays until the map is moved or Places in this area is pressed
fix: On search close, always re-request or restore the last list; a failed lookup must clear request so request_venues does not early-return, or cache a Failed entry; derive list from one query stage enum.

title: Apply-in-place answer rewrites a byte range (or the whole field) recorded at the press, with no check that the draft is unchanged
trigger: In a chat, type a draft, select a word and press the AI apply shortcut; before the answer lands, keep typing earlier in the field (or select-all and type a new draft). The answer arrives.
effect: The answer replaces the stale range (now covering different text) or, with no selection, the whole field, so text typed while waiting is overwritten without a word.
fix: Keep the field's text (or a revision) in ApplyInPlace and drop the answer (with a toast) when the composer no longer holds it, as the conversation key is already checked.

title: load_ai_style_example returns after start_next with no driver, leaving the example loading forever
trigger: Open the style preview (addstyle link) and press 'Another example' while self.live is None (account closing, client gone, demo session). start_next() has set loading and example_asked_at, then `let Some(live) = self.live.as_mut() else { return; }` exits without failed().
effect: The refresh icon spins forever, 'Another example' stays disabled, and ai_style_preview_upkeep requests an animation tick every 60 ms (redraw loop) until the box is closed.
fix: Make the example an enum (Idle, Asked{token, at}, Failed) so every early return goes through one place that leaves Asked, or call failed() on the live-None path.

title: A pending media-timestamp seek outlives the chat it was for and plays or opens media after the reader left
trigger: Click a t.me/c/<chat>/<post>?t=90 link to a voice note or video that is not loaded yet, then open another chat at once. Within 12 s the linked message loads (the history answer that was in flight).
effect: tick_media_seek still runs seek_media_timestamp for the old chat. It starts the voice note or audio playing, or opens the media viewer on the video, over the chat the reader moved to. PlaybackUi::pending_media_seek is cleared only when the seek runs or its deadline passes, never on a chat change.
fix: Make the pending seek part of the chat's ChatUi (replaced whole by sync_chat_ui), or carry the ChatMessage owner and the window and drop the seek when that chat is no longer shown there.

title: A pending linked media timestamp seeks and plays/opens media while the app is locked
trigger: Click a t.me/c/..?t=30 link to a voice note whose message is not loaded yet, then lock Quill (auto-lock or manual) within 12 s.
effect: pump_deep_link calls tick_media_seek before the refused_while_locked return; when the message loads under the lock, seek_media_timestamp starts voice/audio playback or opens the media viewer behind the lock screen.
fix: Move tick_media_seek after the refused_while_locked check (the seek stays pending and runs after the unlock), or hold it as a lock intent.

title: A deep link resolved for an account that left the screen stays in that account's session and fires when the user switches back
trigger: Click a t.me link in account A (or a Join link), immediately switch to account B; the lookup finishes in A's background session (ChatReady/Ui/Info/ShowText). Switch back to A minutes later.
effect: On return, the next poll consumes the stale terminal state: a chat opens, a settings page or an info box appears unasked, in the main window (the flow_window was lost with the old OnScreen). Only the queued link is filtered by account (for_screen); the in-flight/terminal DeepLinkState in the session is not cleared on switch.
fix: Make the flow an OnScreen-owned value (one enum with origin account, window and agent flag) and clear or ignore session.deep_link answers whose screen epoch differs when the account leaves the screen.

title: A thread/media link for a chat that has its own window opens the thread in the asking window's state
trigger: Have chat C open in its own window W and the main window showing another chat; click a t.me/c/C/msg?thread=T link in the main window.
effect: finish_typed_link runs open_thread_view in the asking frame (main) after route_chat_open sent the chat to W: flush_leaving_draft saves main's composer as leaving, and the driver's single thread slot is opened for C while main shows another chat, so main's advance_thread may jump to C duplicating W.
fix: Run finish_typed_link inside in_window_scope(Some(chat_id)) in the windowed branch, like attach_shared_qr_card.

title: Locate times out after 30 s while the macOS permission prompt may still be open
trigger: On macOS first use, open Send Location and leave the system 'Allow location' prompt unanswered for over 30 s, then allow.
effect: poll_answer returns None after LOCATE_TIMEOUT and the picker records Unavailable; the later fix goes to a dropped receiver, so the picker stays 'unavailable' until My Location is pressed.
fix: Let the platform lookup report a Waiting-for-permission state and time out only after the permission is decided; cancel the manager when the receiver is dropped.

title: Phone share answer is matched by bot only; a timed-out send's late answer is reported for the next request
trigger: Mini app requests phone, Share; TDLib takes over 30 s (slow network) so the flow times out and tells the app 'cancelled'; later the app (or the same bot reopened) requests phone again and Share.
effect: The app was told cancelled though the contact card was sent; the stale phone_share (bot, done) then finishes the next request immediately with the old outcome.
fix: Keep the send's RequestId in PhoneFlow::Sending and accept only that answer; clear phone_share when the flow leaves Sending.

title: ingest returns early with ? after the reducer took the pending request, dropping answers captured before apply
trigger: A link-preview, message-link, AI-compose, username-check or instant-view answer arrives in the same envelope while run_post_ingest_pumps, maybe_continue_boost, maybe_load_main_chats, maybe_load_archive_chats or sync_shown_views returns a send error (sender closed).
effect: The captured answer is never stashed: composer chip stays 'Getting link info', copy link / AI text / username verdict / instant view silently lost.
fix: Run the stash steps before any fallible step, or collect errors and return the first at the end as run_post_ingest_pumps does.

title: A user or chat named by Grams history is marked asked even when the request never left
trigger: Open My Grams while the connection is down or chats_path_active is false for a moment; a page lands naming a sender; grams_tick sets peers_dirty=false and tries getUser/getChat.
effect: asked_users/asked_chats get the id on both Ok and Err, and peers_dirty is already cleared, so the row keeps its placeholder for the whole session (missing_* is only filled on an error answer).
fix: Per-peer enum {Unknown, Asked(RequestId), Missing, Known}; set Asked only after a successful send and fall back to Unknown on the Err arm.

title: system_proxy_tick takes proxy.error as its own refusal, which can swallow the error of the user's own proxy action
trigger: Use system proxy mode on, and in the proxy box press Add on a bad proxy right after a system step was sent; the user's mutation fails.
effect: sent.settled is false, so the next tick does proxy.error.take(): the error the user should see is cleared and counted as the system step being refused; the box shows no failure.
fix: Tag the proxy error with the request that produced it (MutateProxy request id) and have the tick consume only its own.

title: maybe_fetch_secret_chat_states drops the rest of the taken queue when one getSecretChat send fails
trigger: Two or more secret chats queued; the send for the first returns an error.
effect: The queue was mem::take n; only the failing id is pushed back, the others are lost, so their state (closed, pending) is never resolved and the composer state for those chats stays unknown.
fix: Re-queue the remaining ids on error (or pop one id at a time).

title: Proxy auto-switch and system-proxy follow run only for the account on screen
trigger: Sign in two accounts, set Use system proxy (or a proxy list with rotation) on account B, switch to account A, then change the OS proxy or kill B's proxy.
effect: The Background tick scope returns before proxy_tick/system_proxy_tick, so B's TDLib client keeps the dead or old proxy, stops receiving messages and notifications until B is shown again.
fix: Run proxy_tick and system_proxy_tick for both scopes (they are per-driver), keep only UI-bound ticks on-screen.

title: Media cache scope is a process-wide OnceLock set by the first account's connect; every later account (switch, background) shares it
trigger: Sign in account A, add account B, switch to B (plan_restore runs for B and calls set_media_cache_scope(B), which is ignored). Play a webm sticker, record a voice note or drop an archive in B.
effect: B's decrypted scratch (gif-frames/<file_id>, captures, video-note-thumbs, archives, file-thumbs) goes under quill-media-cache/<A>; file ids overlap across accounts so discard_frame_cache(file_id) in one account removes the other's extraction dir. The doc claim 'account-scoped' is false once a second account connects.
fix: Drop the global; take the scope from the account on screen (AccountKey in the caller or a per-OnScreen cache base) so the base is replaced with the account.

title: net_watch::latest() re-probes the routing table on the UI thread on every poll while the route reads offline
trigger: Disconnect the network (or have no route to Telegram) and leave Quill open; the screen poll and each background account poll call poll_ticks(.., net_watch::latest()) every pump
effect: Each pump runs route_now(): two UDP bind/connect calls plus a netlink socket (Linux), SCDynamicStore lookups (macOS) or GetBestRoute2 (Windows), all under the tracker mutex that the watcher thread also needs; wasted work and possible UI stalls while offline, multiplied by the number of background accounts
fix: Let the watcher thread own the probe and publish a NetworkState (epoch, available) in an atomic; latest() only reads it, with a rate-limited re-probe owned by the watcher while offline.

title: begin_conference overwrites a join in flight, the first answer is then treated as a rejoin
trigger: Double activate Accept on a conference invitation or link before the first groupCallInfo answers
effect: The first answer no longer matches pending_conference (take_if by request id) so accept_conference_joined skips tracking but still queues a fetch and stores a join payload for an untracked call; the second joins normally
fix: Refuse begin_conference while pending_conference is Some (or cancel the old request id explicitly)

title: Profile edit failure is written to a field only the already-closed Edit Profile dialog shows
trigger: Open Edit Profile, change the name or bio, press Save while the request will fail (flood wait, offline). The save handler sends setName/setBio and calls close_edit_profile_dialog at once (ui/profile_edit_save.rs:107-125), then the error answer arrives.
effect: The box closed as if saved with a silent note 'update requested'; the failure lands in users_state.profile_edit_error, which nothing draws any more. The user believes the profile changed.
fix: Keep the dialog in a Saving stage (enum Editing/Saving{request}/Failed) and close it only on the matching ok, or post the error as a note when no dialog is open.

title: A failed follow-up page of groups in common ends the list for good
trigger: Open a user's profile with more than 40 common groups, scroll to load the next page while offline / on a FLOOD_WAIT: fail_profile_fetch sets exhausted=true and returns.
effect: The list silently stops after the first page; no Retry row, no later page until the profile is closed and reopened (reopening re-fetches).
fix: Failed follow-up returns to `More` (or a `PageFailed` variant with a retry affordance) instead of End; only a short page is End.

title: A transient getMapThumbnailFile error is remembered as 'asked' for the whole session
trigger: Open a chat with location messages while Telegram answers FLOOD_WAIT/timeout for getMapThumbnailFile: failed() removes `awaiting` but keeps the key in `asked`.
effect: Those places keep the coordinate card with no map tile until Quill restarts or 1024 other places are asked; opening the chat again does not retry. The request is also not sweepable, so a lost one never settles via the sweep either.
fix: Per-place `enum Tile { Asking(RequestId), Ready(FileId), Failed{retry_after} }` in one map; Failed retried after a delay or on reconnect.

title: A created or edited invite link turns an unfetched, Loading or Failed link list into Loaded with one entry
trigger: Create an invite link (CreateChatInviteLink) before the chat's link list was fetched, or while getChatInviteLinks is in flight / failed.
effect: The list is marked Loaded with total_count 1 and the new link only; fetch_chat_invite_links skips Loaded, so the other links never show until a manual refresh. If the list answer lands later it overwrites, if it already failed nothing refetches.
fix: Only merge into a Loaded list; for any other state keep the state and mark the list stale so the fetch runs again.

title: updateSupergroupFullInfo and the full-info answer rebuild SupergroupFullInfoData with admin, member_counts, profile and direct_messages_chat_id reset to defaults
trigger: Open a group's manage dialog or permissions box so admin flags (merge_full_admin), restricted/banned counts (session_permissions_box) and the direct-messages chat id (set_direct_messages_chat) are stored; then TDLib sends any updateSupergroupFullInfo (member count change, slow mode, boost) or the info is refetched.
effect: History-visible, hidden-members and sponsored toggles read false, the permissions box rows read 0 restricted/banned, the Gift/location row and the direct-messages link vanish until each side-channel fetch runs again.
fix: Update the existing entry in place (copy only the fields the payload carries) instead of inserting a fresh struct; keep the side-channel parts as separate Fetch<T> values.

title: is_user_action classifies a request by the Debug-name prefix of its purpose (Get/Load/Search/Download/View/Open/Close/SetOnline)
trigger: (1) A user press whose purpose starts with Get/Open/Close (for example getPaymentForm, a close-secret-chat) hits a flood limit: no flood notice. (2) Log out or close: settle_account_requests drops every non-prefixed purpose (Set/Create/Toggle/Send/Edit...) without its failure handler.
effect: Flood notice missing for some user actions; in-flight UI state held by dropped Set*/Create*/Toggle* requests is never settled, and the Session survives a re-login (see session_updates entering Ready), so a spinner or busy marker can stay.
fix: Put a RequestPurpose::kind() (UserAction | Lookup | Auth) on each domain purpose enum, matched exhaustively; settle every non-auth request on logout.

title: Calendar generation restarts at 1 after every close, so a late getChatMessageCalendar answer from an earlier open lands in the new calendar
trigger: In a chat search with the Photos filter open Jump to date (generation 1, page request in flight), close the box (calendar set to None), switch the filter to Video and reopen Jump to date in the same chat (generation 1 again, a second request goes out). The first answer (photo days) matches generation and chat and is accepted.
effect: The calendar highlights days of the wrong media kind; with the same filter the duplicate page has the same cursor, so accept() sees no progress and marks the calendar exhausted, so older months never load.
fix: Take the generation from a counter that lives beside the Option (never reset on close), or store the request id in the calendar and match the answer on it. Same fix in shared_media_months.rs open_shared_media_calendar.

title: Call privacy error flag is wiped by an in-flight answer after a failed send reset the counter
trigger: Open call privacy settings; fetch_call_privacy sends the first getUserPrivacySettingRules, the second send fails (connect/calls/history.rs:244 sets privacy_pending=0, privacy_error=true); the first answer arrives and calls privacy_roundtrip_done.
effect: pending saturates to 0 and privacy_error is set to false, so the failure line disappears and the page looks loaded with one rule unknown. Same for set_call_privacy failing while another roundtrip is in flight.
fix: Replace the counter plus bool by Fetch per rule (AllowCalls, PeerToPeer) keyed by request id; a failed send marks only that rule Failed.

title: A failed Saved Messages tag page marks the filter complete and ends paging with no retry
trigger: Filter Saved Messages by a tag; searchSavedMessages fails (flood wait, offline) on the first or a later page.
effect: fail_saved_tag_page sets loaded=true and history.loaded_complete=true, so fetch_saved_tag_page never asks again: the list is shown as complete (or 'no messages') although it was not loaded; only a new filter retries.
fix: SavedTagSearch.state: enum { Loading(RequestId), Ready{more: bool}, Failed(line) } with a Retry row; loaded_complete only when TDLib said so.

title: A failed sublist page is retried on every scroll event
trigger: Open a Saved Messages sublist while the server answers errors for getSavedMessagesTopicHistory; scroll near the top.
effect: The error only sets chat_action_error (threads/error.rs:94); the view has no failed marker and loaded_complete stays false, so maybe_auto_load_older sends the request again at each history scroll event.
fix: Per-view page state enum with Failed that stops auto-paging until the user taps Retry.

title: A duplicate late first page marks a Saved Messages sublist complete
trigger: Open a sublist, press Back and open the same sublist again quickly; both getSavedMessagesTopicHistory requests answer (the first is not matched, only topic_id is compared).
effect: The second answer adds 0 new rows, so apply_saved_topic_history sets loaded_complete=true; older messages of the sublist never load. next_from_message_id is also overwritten by whichever page arrived last.
fix: Store the awaited RequestId in SavedSublistView (as SavedTagSearch.request does) and apply only that answer; complete only on an empty page.

title: A late reportChatSponsoredMessage answer re-arms the report picker after the user cancelled it
trigger: Right-click a sponsored message, Report; before TDLib answers press Esc (dismiss_sponsored_report clears flight and target); the answer reportSponsoredResultOptionRequired arrives.
effect: accept_sponsored_report is applied on purpose alone (messages/apply.rs:536), finds no flight and no target, uses message_id 0 and stores a new SponsoredReportFlight, so the option picker reopens over a dismissed report; choosing an option reports message 0. A late Ok inserts id 0 into dismissed and the reported ad stays visible.
fix: Make the report flow one enum (Idle, Asking{request,chat,message}, PickingOption{flight}, Done{outcome}) and apply an answer only when its request id equals the Asking request; dismiss returns to Idle and the answer is dropped.

title: A deletion in another chat marks the in-chat search jump as missing
trigger: In a supergroup, search inside the chat and jump to a result (jump Loading or Ready on message id N). Meanwhile a message with the same id N is deleted for good in another supergroup or channel (server message ids repeat across channels).
effect: miss_search_jump compares only message ids, not ChatSearchState::chat_id, so the jump turns Missing and the status line says the message is unavailable for a message that still exists.
fix: Pass the chat id of the deletion and change the jump only when search.chat_search.chat_id matches; better, make the jump carry its ChatMessage key.

title: The system proxy step's result is read from the shared ProxyState::error, not matched to its request
trigger: Use system proxy settings with an OS proxy set. Quill sends a system step (addProxy/editProxy); TDLib refuses it, which sets settings.proxy.error and marks the list stale, so system_proxy_tick returns early until the refetch lands. During that window open Settings > Proxy and save or enable a custom proxy (send_proxy_mutation clears error), and let that call fail.
effect: Before the refetch the proxy box shows an error for a change the user never made; then the user's own failure is taken by system_proxy_tick (error.take()) as the system step's refusal, so the box loses the user's error, the system step is marked refused (waits RETRY = 5 min), or, if the user's call succeeded, the refused system step is resent at once. system_proxy_tick also writes error = None before every send, wiping any error the box is showing.
fix: Give system steps their own RequestPurpose (or keep the RequestId in SentStep) and settle SentStep from that request's answer; never read or clear the user-facing ProxyState::error from the tick.

title: updateDefaultBackground with a null background fails to parse, so a removed default wallpaper is never applied
trigger: On another device (or another Quill session on the same account) remove the default chat wallpaper (deleteDefaultBackground / reset to no wallpaper). TDLib sends updateDefaultBackground with background:null.
effect: parse_chats_payload returns MissingField for the update, the envelope is dropped, and Session::chats_state.default_backgrounds keeps the old wallpaper: Quill keeps drawing the removed default wallpaper until restart. (Quill's own delete_default_background removes the entry optimistically and never restores it when TDLib refuses, the mirror-image leftover.)
fix: Make UpdateDefaultBackground carry Option<Background> and have the reducer remove the theme's entry on None; keep the optimistic delete as a pending value restored on the error arm.

title: Replacing a stopped hub leaves every existing client unrouted on the dead hub's routing table
trigger: The receive thread gives up after MAX_CONSECUTIVE_PANICS; the user then adds an account or reconnects, which calls TdHub::shared and builds a new hub with an empty Routes table.
effect: The old clients' TDLib instances stay open (their envelopes are now dropped as unrouted-client), their bridges report stopped, and reconnecting the same account opens a second TDLib instance on the same database directory, which TDLib refuses while the first holds the lock; the account stays failed until restart.
fix: Keep one Routes (and MAY_BE_OPEN list) for the process and hand it to the replacement hub, so live clients keep their routes across a receive-thread restart.
